buddha.line: Kisa went to the mountain and asked the Buddha
stanza: Kisa went to the mountain and asked the Buddha
"Go to each house and collect a mustard seed
But only from a house where no one's died"
Kisa went to each house in the village
"My baby's getting sicker", poor Kisa cried
But Kisa never collected one mustard seed
Because in every house, someone had died
Kisa sat down in the old village square
She hugged her baby and cried and cried
She said everybody is always losing somebody
Then walked into the forest and buried her child
Were singing at the Savior's feast
And up in the sky an Arabian rabbi
Fed Quaker oats to a priest
